versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes and compatibility updates for IG 454.1.
- Settings rebuilt: new Search to find any setting, faster, new layout, one place per setting, setting links and "New" tags.
- New update check: new versions show at the top of Settings, Update opens your installer app (Feather, AltStore, Sileo...). Can be turned off.
- Privacy: hide your followers & following lists from others, and hide yourself from other people's lists. Saved on your IG account, so it works for everyone.
- iPhone Duo support: Tab Bar editor, feed header button and story buttons now work, folded or unfolded.
- Profile Analyzer rewritten: new native dashboard, one list screen with search, filters, notes & tags, batch follow/unfollow with safety caps, scan history timeline + compare, Growth page (iOS 16+), ghost followers and export.
- Stories Archive rewrite: new Insights (vs the period before, audience, best story & time, top viewers), Story trends charts (iOS 16+), People list with verified & private marks, new viewer profile (seen strip, follow status, timeline filters), saves sticker reactions & votes.
- Reels: Picture in Picture When Leaving — leave IG while a reel plays and it keeps playing in a floating window (IG's own player).
- Feed: Floating Stories Bar (iOS 26+) — a hidden IG feature Regram turns on: the stories bar shrinks into a floating bubble as you scroll; tap it to watch.
- IG Feature Flags (Tools): turn IG's hidden features on/off, search ~38k flags, share links; Try These page of tested picks (e.g. Extra Story Text Styles); crash guard undoes bad changes. Account-security flags are read-only.
- Shortcuts & Links (App Utilities): links that open Regram screens or turn any setting on/off from Shortcuts; asks first unless Skip Confirmation is on. Setting links now work on jailbreak too.
- Media Vault: new photo & video editor, Info screen, Post to IG, rebuilt folders (nested, smart, locked), Date filter and more tools..
- New Show Reel Date (Settings > Reels): see when a reel was posted, above the author; tap for the full date. Custom date format.
- New Show Repost Date (Settings > Reels): tap a repost's avatar on a post or reel to see when they reposted it, when their note expires, and all reposts.
- New Backups: back up Regram's data to Google Drive (on a schedule) or a file, then restore or reset each feature on its own. Older exports still open in Older Backups.
- New Storage & Files: see what takes space, browse IG's folders, clean up caches and set auto clear.
- New IG API page (Settings > App): requests per feature, cache hits, hourly & daily limits, and a live "Paused until…" when IG rate limits or flags the account. Pauses survive relaunch; your own taps are never stopped.
- Background checks (watchlist, follow requests, Media Watch, Save All) now share one paced queue: no burst of requests when IG opens. Checks you start yourself still run at once.
- Chats: action button now also on photos & videos opened in a chat (normal and disappearing): save to Vault, share, expand, repost and more. Same menu as view-once media.
- New Hide in Stories Bar (Ads & Clutter > Stories): hide suggested accounts and recent highlights from the stories bar.
- New video player (Vault, Downloads, Expand): pinch to zoom, double-tap left/right to skip, hold for 2x, speed menu, exact-frame scrubbing, Picture in Picture, AirPlay and Save Frame (to Photos or Vault).
- Clear Cache moved into Storage & Files (Clean Up and Auto Clear). Your Auto Clear schedule carries over.
- Hide UI in Screenshots: now also hides the Quick Controls button in chats and the glass background of all Regram buttons (iOS 26+).
- Feed & profile action buttons: glass now matches IG's buttons (stays solid when Liquid Glass is set to Clear) and bounces when tapped or held.
- New Activity Status button in the chats list: turn your online status on or off in one tap, hold it for more options. Also in Quick Controls.
- Stories action button: new L
